Reintentos del proceso 65 para el pipeline local (como mucho dos por pieza).

    python3 proceso/65-recintos-locales/piezas.py      escribe proceso/65-recintos-locales/piezas_65.json

Toma la pieza del proceso 58 (data/gen3d_piezas.json, sin tocarlo) y cambia la referencia:
semillas 31 (intento a) y 32 (intento b), prompt nuevo y la máscara donde hace falta.
    python3 tools/gen3d_flux_lote.py --archivo proceso/65-recintos-locales/piezas_65.json <clave>
    python3 tools/gen3d_pipeline.py --piezas proceso/65-recintos-locales/piezas_65.json <clave>

comun.estilo: Gouache painting for a historical strategy game, flat opaque color shapes, simple graphic forms, matte paper texture, limited palette.

receta.prompt: {estilo} Inca firewood store of the Andes: a big square stack of split firewood logs, as deep as it is wide, with the round cut ends showing on the front and the side, resting on a low base of grey fieldstone, under a small low hip roof of thick bundled golden ichu straw thatch held by four rough wooden posts at the corners; the logs fill most of the picture and the roof only covers the top. No walls, no house, no crenellations, no tiles, no shingles, no chimney. Team-color details, large and clearly visible from above: a woven cloth band tied around the four posts just under the thatch, painted in one flat uniform pure bright red, the only red in the picture; everything else keeps its natural tones. One single building as a 3D model reference: three-quarter view from above at about 40 degrees, so the top, the front and one side are all visible and the depth reads clearly; the whole building visible and centered, isolated on a plain flat light grey background, no ground, no grass, no terrain, no people, no cast shadow.
